scenarios.title: A creature with fear can be blocked only by artifact creatures and/or black creatures

setup.notes: Severed Legion is a 2/2 black Zombie with fear; Walking Corpse is a black 2/2; Phyrexian Walker is a colorless 0/3 artifact creature; Grizzly Bears is a green 2/2.

decisions: A attacks player B with Severed Legion and Hill Giant.
B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Severed Legion; the other creatures do not block.

variants.label: green_blocker
variants.expected: The block is illegal: Grizzly Bears is neither an artifact creature nor a black creature.

variants.label: black_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Walking Corpse blocking Severed Legion instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Walking Corpse is a black creature.

variants.label: artifact_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Phyrexian Walker blocking Severed Legion instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Phyrexian Walker is an artifact creature.

variants.label: green_blocks_plain
variants.delta: B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Hill Giant instead.
variants.expected: The block is legal: Hill Giant has no fear.

scenarios.title: A second instance of fear does not change the blocking restriction

setup.notes: The Aura Fear is attached to Severed Legion, which already has fear, so it has two instances of fear.

decisions: A attacks player B with Severed Legion.
B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Severed Legion; Walking Corpse does not block.

variants.label: green_blocker
variants.expected: The block is illegal: with two instances of fear Severed Legion is still blockable only by artifact and/or black creatures.

variants.label: black_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Walking Corpse blocking Severed Legion instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Walking Corpse is a black creature.
